mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recommendation_task ( recommendation_id, account_id, patient_id, request_hash, status_code, failure_code, profile_version, pantry_version, created_at, updated_at, active_scope_key, request_json) VALUES (#{recommendationId}, #{accountId}, #{patientId}, #{requestHash}, #{statusCode}, NULL, #{profileVersion}, #{pantryVersion}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{scopeKey}, #{requestJson})
mapper.update: UPDATE recommendation_task SET status_code = #{statusCode}, failure_code = #{failureCode}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, conflict_json = #{conflictJson}, active_scope_key = CASE WHEN #{openFlag} = 1 THEN active_scope_key ELSE NULL END WHERE recommendation_id = #{recommendationId}
mapper.select: SELECT recommendation_id, account_id, status_code, failure_code, created_at, updated_at, request_json, conflict_json FROM recommendation_task WHERE recommendation_id = #{recommendationId}
